title: Unit – 4 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2  |  Odd Man Out — Generation of Control Signals
sections: 1. Group Opcode, Operand, Clock, Condition Code → Clock — a timing reference; the others are instruction/state information that feed control-signal generation.
2. Group Control Memory, ALU, Decoder, Flip-flops → ALU — a data-processing unit; the others are control-path elements.
3. Group MEMREAD, MEMWRITE, ALUOP, DATAPATH → DATAPATH — a hardware structure; the others are control signals.
4. Group Hardwired, Microprogrammed, Combinational, RISC → RISC — an ISA design style; the others are control-unit implementation approaches.
5. Group Sequence Counter, Program Counter, Instruction Register, Control Store → Control Store — exists only in microprogrammed units; the others are general processor registers/counters.
6. Group Horizontal Microcode, Vertical Microcode, Nanocode, Opcode → Opcode — an instruction field; the others are microprogram encoding formats.
7. Group AND gate, OR gate, Decoder, Cache Memory → Cache Memory — a storage structure; the others are logic elements.
8. Group Fetch, Decode, Execute, Compile → Compile — a software translation step; the others are hardware instruction-cycle stages.
9. Group Control Signal, Data Signal, Address Signal, Interrupt Signal → Interrupt Signal — an asynchronous event line; the others are the three standard bus signal groups.

10. Group Finite State Machine, Control Matrix, Pipeline Registers, Branch Predictor → Branch Predictor — a performance feature; the others are structures used to implement/generate control sequencing.
